training_method.objective_quote: We bypass the SFT stage entirely and adopt pure GRPO training, which enables reward-based autonomous reasoning.

description.text: ProGuard is a proactive multimodal safeguard model. It is designed to identify and reason about unknown risks across both text and visual modalities, moving beyond rigid predefined classification systems.

serving.notes: The live model page text matches the cached card. The model was last modified on 2026-02-15, before the cache date. Appendix C states learning rate 1e-6, batch size 512, group size 16, and 1 epoch, and then says those settings train the Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct backbone, so they are not recorded as this 3B checkpoint's numbers. config.json text_config _name_or_path is /mnt/shared-storage-user/yushaohan/ckpt-3b/global_step_138/actor/huggingface. Hub safetensors total is 4065787904 BF16. The chat template inserts 'You are a helpful assistant.' when the first message is not a system message. Deploy also has an image-only mode. No license field is on the card. No adapter file. GitHub training is proguard-train.sh under verl. DeepSafe is cited as a toolkit that uses the model, not as this checkpoint's trainer.

evaluation_reported.text: The paper's ProGuard-3B rows include prompt-harm F1 scores 82.51, 89.20, 77.02, 99.50, 95.03, 86.44, 88.25, and 88.49, and it says ProGuard improves OOD risk detection by 52.6% and OOD risk description by 64.8%.
